come.en: Please come to my party on Sunday.

join.en: I want to join the music club.
Many children join the game on the playground.
join.cn: 很多孩子在操场上加入游戏。

game.en: We play a fun game in the English class.
game.cn: 我们在英语课上玩一个有趣的游戏。

party.en: Mum makes a cake for my birthday party.
party.cn: 妈妈为我的生日聚会做了一个蛋糕。

together.en: We are stronger when we play and learn together.
together.cn: 一起玩、一起学，我们才更强大。

welcome.en: The teacher welcomes the new students with a smile.
welcome.cn: 老师微笑着欢迎新同学。

friend.en: A true friend helps you when you are in trouble.
friend.cn: 真正的朋友会在你遇到困难时帮助你。

sure.en: Are you sure you want to come with us?
sure.cn: 你确定要和我们一起来吗？
